dialogue.speaker: Tom
dialogue.text: Passengers for flight 304, I am sorry to say your flight has been cancelled.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Excuse me, what happened? I have an important connection later today.

dialogue.speaker: Tom
dialogue.text: There was a technical problem with the plane. We apologize for the delay.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Can you rebook me on another flight today?

dialogue.speaker: Tom
dialogue.text: There is a flight at eight tonight. Let me check if there are seats.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Please do. If not, what are my options?

dialogue.speaker: Tom
dialogue.text: We can offer you a hotel and a flight tomorrow morning.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: I would prefer to travel tonight. Is there compensation for the inconvenience?

dialogue.speaker: Tom
dialogue.text: Yes, you have the right to compensation, and I will give you the form.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Thank you. Do I also receive a meal voucher?

dialogue.speaker: Tom
dialogue.text: Yes, here is a voucher for the restaurant. You are on the eight o'clock flight.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Great, that solves my problem. I really appreciate your help.
